On February 10, 2026 (regular season), Indiana beat New York 137-134 in overtime. The Knicks led 69-63 at halftime. In the second half Indiana outscored New York 61-55, and in overtime Indiana won the extra period 13-10 — matching the final three-point margin. The period data show the scoring flow; they don't establish why it happened.

On Nov 22, the game's decisive swing came late in the third quarter. Orlando took the lead for good with a Bane 27-foot step-back three at Q3 00:32, making it 93-96, and that go-ahead score was part of a 5-0 Orlando run (93-93 to 93-98) from Q3 00:32 to Q3 00:09.

Broader flow: New York built a 10-point lead (15-5 at Q1 08:08), but Orlando's largest run was 14-0 (15-5 to 15-19, Q1 07:34 to 04:39). Orlando's largest lead reached 18 (104-122 at Q4 06:18). Final: New York 121, Orlando 133.

Note: this was a Knicks road win over Orlando (NYK 132, ORL 120 on Dec 13, 2025), not an Orlando win. The largest quarter swing for New York was Q2, which the Knicks won 38-28 (+10). Quarter-by-quarter from the Knicks' perspective: Q1 33-36 (-3), Q2 38-28 (+10), Q3 29-28 (+1), Q4 32-28 (+4).

That score began New York's decisive 11-0 run from Q4 04:15 to Q4 02:53, moving the score from 103-104 to 114-104. The Knicks' largest lead was 11 points (123-112 at Q4 00:35).
